text:
Ava Lin: Kickoff: marketplace co-launch with PartnerX. Need owners: blog, marketplace assets, micro-bench, webinar, lead routing. Short replies ok. :wave:
Marco Diaz: I can own the blog + hero copy. Propose publish 10 days before webinar. Need partner quote + logo by Nov 20.
Priya Shah: Webinar ops: Dec 12 @ 16:00 UTC works. Run-of-show: 5m intro, 18m demo, 10m benchmarks, 15m partner panel, 12m Q&A. Dry run Dec 9.
Connor Lee: Bench scope: p50 latency @512, p95 @1024, throughput (req/s) on 4-GPU profile, and $/1k tokens. Methods paragraph + link to repo. Need infra lock to run numbers.
Ava Lin: Marketplace assets checklist: 1200x628 co-brand hero, logo (png/svg), 200-250 word blurb, 2 screenshots (console + integration). Assets due Nov 28.
Marco Diaz: Blog outline: partner value, 3-step setup, bench highlights, CTA to webinar. Draft by Nov 18.
Priya Shah: Promo cadence: announce T-21, reminder T-7, final T-1, replay T+1. Request partner promo clip (30s).
Connor Lee: Routing: marketplace leads -> HubSpot form -> tag partnerx_marketplace -> set product_interest & lead_age -> route to regional SDR pools. SLA: 24h. MQL when company_size>50 or title contains Engineer/PM.
Ava Lin: UTM scheme: utm_source=partnerx_market, utm_medium=partner, utm_campaign=partnerx-dec. Use across blog, emails, partner assets.
partners-bot: Reminder created: "PartnerX co-launch dry run" scheduled 2024-12-09 15:00 UTC.
Ava Lin: Action recap: Marco=blog+copy, Priya=webinar ops+calendar, Connor=bench+methods, partner=assets+quote. I'll send a GDoc with deadlines and a calendar invite. Thanks everyone!
